a1cd5703b5.h: تحالف سياسي جديد في إسرائيل يضم حزبي آيزنكوت و«الديمقراطيون»
p: أعلن حزب «الديمقراطيون» اليساري وحزب «يشار» الذي يتزعمه غادي آيزنكوت، يوم الخميس، عن إبرام اتفاق سياسي مشترك يهدف لتأسيس الائتلاف الحكومي القادم في إسرائيل.
وتأتي هذه الخطوة لتدعم موقف آيزنكوت وتحالفه السياسي، غير أن الأغلبية المطلوبة لتولي الحكم لم تكتمل بعد لصالح هذا التجمع الجديد.

46538bafc3.h: Egypt and Qatar Urge Gaza Ceasefire and Closer Economic Ties
p: During a meeting in Cairo on Thursday, Egyptian President Abdel Fattah Al-Sisi and Qatari Emir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani emphasized the urgency for all involved sides to adhere to the Gaza Strip ceasefire accord. The Egyptian presidency reported that the leaders also highlighted the necessity of securing humanitarian relief delivery and initiating early recovery and reconstruction efforts promptly.
Furthermore, the discussions between the two leaders focused on regional de-escalation alongside the enhancement of bilateral cooperation in the economic and energy sectors.

373ca5ec53.h: Coalition Spokesman Blames Houthi Militia for Jazan Refinery Assault
p: RIYADH: Houthi forces targeted the petroleum facility in Jazan, a military official announced. Maj. Gen. Turki Al-Maliki, who speaks for the coalition backing the legitimate government in Yemen, confirmed the hostile action through official channels.
A strong military retaliation will face any attempts to strike non-combatants and civilian infrastructure, the spokesman warned in a statement published by the Saudi Press Agency.

9c217f470f.h: ناجون يروون أهوال انفجار شاحنة الوقود في الجيزة
p: نقل شهود عيان تفاصيل مرعبة عما عاشوه، خلال حادث انفجار شاحنة وقود وقع على الطريق الدائري بنطاق محافظة الجيزة في مصر.
وأعرب هؤلاء الشهود عن صدمتهم البالغة إزاء المشاهد المروعة التي لحقت بالمكان جراء احتراق الشاحنة المحملة بالمواد البترولية.

5407c12769.h: Saudi Deputy Foreign Minister Updates Ambassadors on Houthi Assaults
p: Dr. Saud Al-Sati, the deputy minister for political affairs at the Saudi Ministry of Foreign Affairs, hosted diplomatic envoys stationed in the Kingdom for a series of briefings. The gatherings took place at the ministry headquarters in Riyadh during Wednesday and Thursday.

During these sessions, the ambassadors received detailed updates regarding Houthi assaults directed at Saudi Arabia. The meetings also included Maj. Gen. Turki Al-Maliki, who serves as the spokesman for the Coalition to Support Legitimacy in Yemen.

d16b65efbb.h: Army Was Aware of Explosive Hazards at Iowa Facility Over a Year Ago
p: New evidence indicates that the military branch was cognizant of instability concerns regarding explosives at an Iowa facility significantly earlier than previously understood. Initiatives aimed at eliminating these hazardous materials commenced over twelve months ago.
However, the disposal process was left unfinished during that initial period. This delay ultimately created the conditions that led to the controversial explosion on Wednesday.

5a59a4cf47.h: Two Italian Nationals Die in Kuwait Following Iranian Drone Strike
p: Officials have confirmed that two people from Italy lost their lives during an Iranian drone assault targeting Kuwait.

This tragic incident occurs amid a succession of recent attacks directed at Gulf Arab nations containing American military installations. Meanwhile, negotiations aimed at halting the ongoing conflict remain deadlocked.

214ad1a4c0.h: Egyptian Business Tycoons Pledge EGP 30m for Ring Road Fire Victims
p: Three prominent Egyptian entrepreneurs have committed a total of EGP 30m to assist the households impacted by a recent blaze on the Ring Road in Al-Warraq, according to a cabinet announcement on Thursday.
Cabinet spokesperson Counselor Mohamed Adel reported that officials received multiple support proposals from business sector representatives following the Greater Cairo tragedy.

c9daf847ec.h: SFDA and SWA Partner to Broaden Institutional Cooperation
p: The Saudi Food and Drug Authority and the Saudi Water Authority have formally entered into a memorandum of understanding aimed at deepening coordination and partnership across multiple shared domains in Riyadh.

Dr. Hisham Aljadhey, who leads the SFDA as CEO, joined SWA President Eng. Abdullah Al-Abdulkarim to finalize the agreement. The pact focuses on collaborative efforts in research and studies, alongside the utilization of shared capabilities between the two organizations.

a5a563c2a3.h: Two Italian Technicians Killed in Kuwait Strike Amid Iranian Denials
p: A strike in Kuwait resulted in the deaths of two Italian nationals. According to information provided by the foreign ministry of Italy, both victims worked as technicians for Rheinmetall, a German business.
Meanwhile, the Iranian government has rejected claims that it was involved in the incident.

a960804b5b.h: Saudi Leaders Express Condolences to Egypt's President Over Giza Blaze
p: King Salman and Crown Prince and Prime Minister Mohammed bin Salman sent messages of condolence to Egyptian President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi. The Saudi leaders conveyed their profound sympathies regarding the deadly fire incident in the Al-Warraq neighborhood located in the Giza governorate.

The Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques and the Crown Prince communicated their sorrow through separate dispatches addressed to the Egyptian head of state, mourning those who lost their lives in the disaster.

6b3ddbaa22.h: Strobe Talbott, Former Diplomat and Time Magazine Journalist, Passes Away at 80
p: Strobe Talbott, who transitioned from working as a foreign policy columnist and reporter for Time to holding a high-ranking position in the State Department, has died at the age of eighty.
During his career, he functioned as the deputy secretary of state. Later, he also took on the role of president at the Brookings Institution.

93af6dccb9.h: اتفاق ائتلافي بين آيزنكوت وحزب الديمقراطيون وسط انقسامات سياسية
p: أعلن حزب غادي آيزنكوت المكلف بتشكيل الحكومة الإسرائيلية المقبلة، وحزب "الديمقراطيون" اليساري، عن توقيع اتفاق ائتلاف حكومي بين الجانبين، وذلك يوم الخميس.
يأتي هذا التفاهم ليكون الخطوة الثانية من نوعها بعد تفاهم مسبق مع حزب "إسرائيل بيتنا" اليميني، في ظل وجود انقسامات عميقة تواجه المعسكر المعارض لبنيامين نتانياهو تتعلق بالتحالفات المحتملة.

90d010a174.h: Iran Engineers Create Robotic Dog for Risky Search and Rescue
p: Engineers in Iran have created a four-legged robotic dog to aid search-and-rescue missions within dangerous settings, according to a report by Mehr News Agency, which is a TV BRICS partner. This robotic platform is capable of evaluating its environment, locating individuals trapped beneath debris, and transporting emergency supplies.
The machine features human-presence radar, gas sensors, and thermal and night-vision cameras, alongside various other systems.

91fe6a6e7d.h: Kingdom condemns deadly Iranian attack on vital Kuwaiti site
p: RIYADH — The Ministry of Foreign Affairs issued a statement expressing the Kingdom's strongest condemnation of the heinous Iranian aggression directed at a vital location within Kuwait. The assault resulted in multiple casualties, leaving several people dead and injured.

The ministry warned that ongoing Iranian strikes contribute to heightened instability and further escalation of tensions in the region. Furthermore, the Saudi government reiterated its stance regarding these ongoing violations.

c33f90708a.h: Israeli Judges Advise Reconsidering Major Bribery Charges Against Netanyahu
p: Judges presiding over the protracted legal proceedings involving Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu have recommended abandoning a central corruption charge. The ongoing trial, which has caused deep polarization across the nation, centers on allegations of fraud, breach of trust, and bribery.
The prime minister has consistently maintained his innocence, rejecting every accusation leveled against him throughout the duration of the judicial process.

45c8aae3ab.h: ASEAN Specialists Tour Moscow ATOM Museum to Study Russian Nuclear Sector
p: Participants in the InteRussia international educational fellowship program "Changing Energy Landscape" recently toured the ATOM Museum located at VDNKh in Moscow. The delegation consisted of professionals hailing from various ASEAN member states, specifically Indonesia, Vietnam, Malaysia, Cambodia, and the Philippines.

During the museum visit, the visiting fellows examined an exhibition showcasing the Russian nuclear sector. The tour provided the international specialists with an opportunity to learn about the historical background of the industry.

fa1837e2c9.h: Ministry Announces Progress on Urban Spaces and Housing Targets
p: The Ministry of Municipalities and Housing reported that urban environment enhancement initiatives have successfully placed 77 percent of inhabitants within an 800-meter proximity of public areas, according to spokesperson Ahmed Al-Dhafiri. These ongoing projects encompass the creation of waterfronts.
Additionally, the ministry outlined its goals for the year 2027, which involve providing a total of 80,000 residential plots and housing units.

c104b9cb02.h: العراق يبدأ إغلاق المنافذ غير الرسمية لوقف خسائر بمليارات الدولارات
p: شرعت السلطات العراقية في تنفيذ خطوة لإغلاق المعابر الحدودية غير الرسمية، في مسعى للسيطرة على الحدود الدولية ومواجهة شبكات التهريب.

وأوضح المتحدث باسم الحكومة، حيدر العبودي، أن هذه الإجراءات تهدف إلى وضع حد لهدر الثروة السيادية للبلاد، والتي قدرت الخسائر الناتجة عنها بنحو 100 مليار دولار، مشدداً على أن الملاحقة القانونية ستطال كل من يثبت تورطه في هذا الملف.

e3af78e55c.h: Russia and Kazakhstan Reach 96% in National Currency Settlements, Putin States
p: Nearly all trade transactions between Russia and Kazakhstan are now settled using their domestic currencies, according to statements made by Russian President Vladimir Putin. During a gathering with Kazakh President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev, Putin noted that national currencies account for approximately 96 percent of bilateral exchanges. Details of the discussion were published by the Kremlin's official website.

Additionally, Putin highlighted that the commercial exchange volume between the two nations has surpassed twenty-eight billion US dollars and is steadily nearing the thirty billion US dollar threshold. President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev acknowledged and confirmed these trade figures during their talks.

e8966e20b8.h: Coalition Neutralizes Houthi Military Assets and Missile Launcher in Yemen
p: The Coalition to Restore Legitimacy in Yemen executed targeted military strikes aimed at degrading the capabilities of the Houthi militia. Maj. Gen. Turki Al-Maliki, the spokesperson for the Coalition, reported that the precise operation successfully dismantled fifty legitimate military targets.

According to Al-Maliki, these operations took place across the governorates of Sanaa, Hodeidah, and Saada. Additionally, Coalition forces succeeded in destroying a ballistic missile launcher during the campaign.

397f627066.h: توقف مباراة بشكتاش وهابوعيل بئر السبع بسبب اشتباكات في جورجيا
p: شهدت مواجهة نادي بشكتاش التركي ونظيره هابوعيل بئر السبع الإسرائيلي ضمن منافسات الدوري الأوروبي لكرة القدم يوم الخميس توقفا اضطراريا.
جاء تعليق اللقاء لمدة نصف ساعة على خلفية وقوع مواجهات خشنة بين أفراد الشرطة الجورجية وجماهير الفريق التركي داخل المدرجات.

fdbcd85740.h: TMG and Tamer Hosny Delay Madinaty Concert Over Ring Road Tragedy
p: Talaat Moustafa Group alongside Egyptian vocalist Tamer Hosny have decided to push back their upcoming performance in Madinaty. The event, initially set for November 27, will now take place on December 4. Organizers stated the delay is a gesture of solidarity with the relatives of those who died in a severe accident on the Ring Road.
Individuals who already secured tickets for the original date can still use them for the rescheduled December concert, as current passes remain fully valid.

4ee129bb32.h: Saudi Arabia Warns UN Security Council of Terrorist Tech Exploitation
p: During a United Nations Security Council open debate addressing conflict resolution and rapid technological advancement, Saudi Arabia expressed serious concern regarding extremist organizations leveraging new innovations. Faris Al-Otaibi, the Acting Chargé d'Affaires of the Saudi Permanent Mission to the UN in New York, highlighted the specific threat of militant factions utilizing technological components to build military capabilities.
The warning delivered in New York emphasizes the Kingdom's vigilance regarding modern security challenges at the international level.

94d2e60bc9.h: Severe US Thanksgiving storms cause widespread flooding and flight delays
p: A massive Thanksgiving weather system is impacting both the eastern and western coasts of the United States, bringing heavy rainfall and severe flooding. The severe weather has also led to widespread flight delays nationwide.
Strong winds have knocked down trees and caused electricity blackouts affecting hundreds of thousands of users.

d6f3629f63.h: Driver Held Over Cairo Ring Road Tanker Fire
p: Egyptian authorities have placed the driver responsible for a fiery fuel tanker crash on the Cairo Ring Road in Warraq into custody. The incident occurred on Wednesday when the vehicle flipped over and burst into flames.

During interrogation by the Public Prosecution, the suspect acknowledged operating the vehicle alongside his father. Meanwhile, Prime Minister Mostafa Madbouly went to the hospital to check on individuals injured in the accident.

84abd43c27.h: Filipino Families Seek Justice Ahead of ICC Proceedings for Duterte
p: Relatives of deceased Filipinos are pursuing accountability as former Philippine President Rodrigo Duterte prepares to face the International Criminal Court. The former leader is accused of crimes against humanity, which involve eighty-five homicides.
The legal proceedings are projected to extend through 2027, providing an opportunity for victims of the alleged atrocities to deliver testimony during the court sessions.

cfbf2b1dc6.h: Expectant Prisoner Flees via New Mexico Transport SUV
p: A 26-year-old incarcerated woman named Rebecca Taylor seized control of a sport utility vehicle during her transit back to a correctional facility, according to law enforcement officials.
The incident occurred at a Whataburger parking lot while officers were returning Taylor from a medical visit related to her pregnancy.

540b51f494.h: UK Set to Cover Costs for EU Programme Access
p: Freshly published legal texts have uncovered the United Kingdom's obligation to cover a financial contribution in order to participate in European Union arrangements.
The newly disclosed documentation outlines the specific administrative costs the British government will cover as a participation fee for these cross-border agreements.

585b336a14.h: New Zealand Coalition Misses Parliamentary Majority by Single Seat
p: The right-leaning governing alliance headed by the National Party has missed securing the necessary majority in parliament.
According to the latest outcome, the ruling bloc trails the required threshold to govern outright by a single seat.

fdbaea372d.h: Turkish Airlines Launches Africa Fly Fest with Cairo Fares From $240
p: Turkish Airlines has introduced its Africa Fly Fest promotional campaign, featuring round-trip economy tickets connecting Cairo and Istanbul starting at the price of $240. This announcement coincides with the airline celebrating seventy-five years of operating flights to the Egyptian capital.

The promotional event additionally includes various international destinations accessible through Istanbul. Under this campaign, round-trip journeys originating from Cairo are priced beginning at $430 for Munich and Frankfurt, $445 for Paris, and $450 for other included locations.

93565e5927.h: Riyadh Strongly Condemns Terrorist Raid on Syrian Security Site in Al-Hasakah
p: Saudi Arabia has expressed its strong condemnation regarding a recent terrorist assault directed at a Syrian security forces location situated within the Al-Hasakah Governorate.

Through a formal announcement released on Thursday via the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Kingdom emphasized its complete opposition to terrorism, extremism, and all acts of violence. Furthermore, Saudi Arabia declared its steadfast backing for the Syrian government.

077b0a4463.h: Pacifica Pier Damaged After Section Falls Into Ocean
p: Residents in Pacifica, California, are concerned about the future of their well-known pier following a recent collapse. The structure, which had experienced deterioration over an extended period, suffered significant damage this week when powerful waves caused a segment to break off and drop into the ocean.

1aa5ac9260.h: UK media spotlight Labour opposition to Rosebank and controversy surrounding Huw
p: British newspapers report that a significant number of Labour lawmakers are speaking out against the Rosebank oil and gas project. Additionally, headlines have turned their attention toward controversy involving an individual referred to as Huw.
The unfolding stories have captured considerable media interest across the United Kingdom, highlighting internal party dynamics and public figures currently under scrutiny.

adead3b734.h: أوكرانيا تؤكد عدم رغبتها في نقل معاركها إلى ليبيا
p: شدد وزير الخارجية الأوكراني أندري سيبيها على غياب أي نية لدى كييف لنقل صراعها العسكري مع موسكو نحو الأراضي أو المياه الليبية.
وجاء هذا الموقف الرسمي الأوكراني إثر تعرض سفينتين تابعتين لروسيا لعمليات استهداف بالقرب من شواطئ مدينة بنغازي.

8d73c1d90d.h: Tech Revolution Reshapes Cinema Away From Studio Control
p: The movie industry has shifted away from the traditional dominance of major production companies and established cinematic institutions. Two decades ago, distributors and theater exhibitors largely dictated creative opportunities in the field.

Advancements in technology have fundamentally altered this environment. Mobile phones now function as versatile tools for creating films, shifting the balance of power in the modern cinematic landscape.

cb7eedbb67.h: Saudi Arabia Sends Condolences to Egypt Following Fatal Giza Fuel Tanker Blast
p: Riyadh has shared its profound sympathies with Egypt and the relatives of those who perished in a fuel tanker blast that resulted in thirty-one deaths and twenty-one injuries.
Through a Thursday announcement from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Kingdom expressed its sorrow over the tragedy that occurred along the Ring Road located in the Giza Governorate.

eb3c96ec75.h: An Unusual Thanksgiving Following the Iowa Ammunition Plant Blast
p: Relatives assembled at a southeast Iowa farmhouse on the day following a blast at an ammunition plant. The atmosphere inside the residence carried the distinct impression that a severe storm had recently moved through the area.

This peculiar holiday gathering brought the household together under extraordinary circumstances, highlighting the immediate aftermath of the violent explosion that shook the region just one day prior.

2ef3104a86.h: BBC Investigation Uncovers Large-Scale Scam Networks Involving Plumbers and Electricians
p: A BBC investigation has exposed widespread fraudulent activities orchestrated by organized rings of electricians and plumbers. These networks are reported to be targeting consumers on a massive scale, leading to exorbitant charges for services that often begin with seemingly modest initial fees.

The findings shed light on the sophisticated methods utilized by these dishonest operators to extract huge sums from unsuspecting individuals. Authorities and consumer advocates continue to examine the full extent of these deceptive industry practices.

86643d2bd6.h: ترامب يبرئ جنسن هوانغ من التهديدات الأمنية ويثني على دور إدارته
p: أوضح الرئيس الأميركي دونالد ترامب، يوم الخميس، عقب اطلاعه على تفاصيل وافية، أن جنسن هوانغ الرئيس التنفيذي لشركة إنفيديا لا يمثل أي خطر على الأمن.
وفي السياق ذاته، أشاد ترامب بالجهود التي بذلتها إدارته وأفضت إلى عودة هوانغ لموقعه القيادي.

27cf4b140b.h: Egypt and Qatar Chiefs Confer on Iran Mediation and Financial Ties in Cairo
p: Egyptian Foreign Minister Badr Abdelatty welcomed Qatari Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani in Cairo on Wednesday. Their meeting focused on bilateral cooperation and broader regional matters.

According to foreign ministry spokesperson Ambassador Nader Zaki, the discussions covered the ongoing crisis involving Iran alongside current mediation efforts, alongside a review of economic relations between the two nations.

4e1062961f.h: Nepali Employee Killed in Houthi Strike on Saudi Refinery
p: An assault by Houthi forces targeting a petroleum facility in Jazan, Saudi Arabia, has left one Nepali laborer dead and multiple people injured. Following the incident, the Ministry of Energy temporarily halted certain activities at the site to evaluate the extent of the harm.

In response to the escalation, the Coalition to Restore Legitimacy in Yemen announced that coalition forces located and demolished the ballistic missile launcher responsible for the strike in Hodeidah.

3f2b777bd4.h: Cross-Party AI Regulation Push Meets Legislative Hurdles in Congress
p: Lawmakers from opposing political factions express a shared interest in establishing rules for artificial intelligence. However, several barriers threaten to impede these efforts on Capitol Hill.
Jurisdictional disputes among committees and the traditionally sluggish legislative process are identified as major roadblocks that could hinder lawmakers from successfully enacting AI policies.

ea85f82e9b.h: MoD Lacks Necessary Expertise to Fix Armed Forces Housing, MPs Warn
p: Parliamentary members have issued a warning stating that the Ministry of Defence is severely deficient in the skills and knowledge required to upgrade substandard accommodation provided to military families.
According to the MPs, this significant lack of expertise hinders the department's ability to successfully overhaul the poor-quality homes.

b467221dd8.h: Can Roof Tiles Cut Indoor Heat? India Tests Solutions
p: Rising temperatures have prompted researchers in India to test methods for improving comfort for vulnerable populations.
Investigators are specifically examining whether roof tiles can effectively lower indoor heat during periods of extreme warmth.

b850240d53.h: Saudi Air Defenses Destroy Ballistic Missiles and Drones Targeting Riyadh and Eastern Province
p: Saudi Arabia's air defense forces successfully intercepted and neutralized a pair of ballistic missiles aimed at the capital city of Riyadh. The hostile projectiles were launched by the Houthi terrorist militia, according to official statements.

In addition to the action over the capital, defense forces also detected and destroyed two unmanned drones operating in the Eastern Province. The military updates were provided by Maj. Gen. Turki Al-Maliki, who serves as the spokesperson for the Coalition to Restore Legitimacy in Yemen.

44da2f067e.h: Francesca Hong Reflects on Past Thanksgiving Controversy With Humor
p: Francesca Hong is looking back at a previous social media controversy with humor, acknowledging regret over a digital message that criticized Thanksgiving during her campaign for the Democratic gubernatorial nomination in Wisconsin.
The former candidate, who faced significant criticism at the time for her holiday remarks, is now able to laugh about the incident as the annual holiday returns.

403829cc27.h: Ministry of Defence Lacks Email Contacts for Roughly Half of Reservist Force
p: The Ministry of Defence currently possesses digital contact details for only a portion of its approximately 95,000 reservists.
Because of this missing electronic information, authorities have been limited to reaching out via postal mail to roughly 50,000 members of the reserve forces.

80dc4e11a8.h: CSIR Opens Recruitment for Applicants Ranging from 10th Pass to Graduates
p: The Council Of Scientific And Industrial Research has announced a recruitment drive welcoming applicants with educational qualifications spanning from the 10th pass level up to university graduates.

Individuals wishing to apply are strongly urged by authorities to submit their documentation early, rather than waiting until the final deadline. Furthermore, officials have clarified that no appeals for extending the submission period will be accepted under any circumstances.

251c853beb.h: Strobe Talbott, Former Deputy Secretary of State and Journalist, Passes Away at 80
p: Strobe Talbott, who worked as a journalist for Time magazine before holding the position of deputy secretary of state during the administration of President Bill Clinton, has passed away at the age of 80 on Thursday.
In addition to his journalism and government service, Talbott also led the Brookings Institution.

937445831f.h: Houthi Strike on Southwestern Saudi Refinery Leaves One Dead and Multiple Injured
p: A citizen of Nepal lost their life and numerous individuals sustained injuries following a strike orchestrated by Houthi forces against a petroleum refinery situated in Jazan. The energy department in the Kingdom confirmed that the assault occurred on Thursday in the southwestern municipality, which is located close to the border with Yemen.

This aggressive action represents the most recent in a series of hostile measures targeting vital Saudi infrastructure. The incident transpired a day following the militant faction's declaration of responsibility for targeting the major oil export facility and largest refinery located in Ras Tanura.

121827016c.h: Trump Administration SNAP Reductions Put Free School Meals at Risk
p: Modifications and reductions to the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program introduced by the Trump administration carry implications for school breakfast and lunch programs.
The proposed regulatory updates and benefit reductions to SNAP could impact the availability of these complimentary meals for students.

46fc543aaf.h: Historic Victorian railway station preserved for decades put on the market
p: A historic Victorian railway station that has remained entirely unaltered for seven decades is currently being offered for sale. The property still contains a variety of vintage railway items inside, featuring old signal lamps alongside personal luggage.
Among the preserved artifacts left behind in the building is a suitcase, offering a glimpse into the past of the dormant site.

fa279bc8c0.h: HBSE Releases 2027 Board Examination Schedule for Classes 10 and 12
p: The examination board has officially released the schedule for the upcoming board assessments through a recent press release. According to the announcement, students in both high school and senior secondary levels can prepare for their tests to commence in March.
Specifically, the Senior Secondary examinations are scheduled to kick off on March 3, 2027. Meanwhile, the Secondary level tests will get underway shortly after, starting on March 4, 2027.

0b52388aa8.h: هيلتون تعزز حضورها في مصر بأكثر من 60 فندقاً واستثمارات ضخمة
p: كشفت شركة هيلتون، المسجلة في بورصة ناسداك بالولايات المتحدة، يوم الجمعة، عن زيادة عدد منشآت الفنادق التابعة لها داخل الأراضي المصرية، لتتجاوز ستين منشأة ما بين فنادق عاملة وأخرى تحت الإنشاء.

وصل إجمالي حجم الاستثمارات الخاصة بمحفظة الشركة المتنامية في مصر إلى 1.6 مليار دولار، تم توفيرها عبر المستثمرين وأصحاب الفنادق، مما يمثل محطة محورية في تاريخ الشركة بواحدة من أبرز الأسواق التاريخية لها عالمياً.

d63f0b363c.h: Examining Iran and Arab Allies' Underground Warfare Dynamics
p: Conventional beliefs often portray Tehran as the primary provider of funds, weaponry, instruction, technical expertise, and ideological guidance for its non-state partners in the Arab world, effectively dictating their daily actions.

While Iran certainly plays a major part, the idea that groups like Lebanon's Hezbollah, Gaza's Hamas, and Yemen's Houthis function simply as direct extensions of Iranian power is subject to re-evaluation.

4635f09beb.h: Philliadelphia Deli Owner Thanks Community After Stolen Van Recovered
p: A traditional Philadelphia sandwich shop expressed appreciation to local patrons who took action following the recent theft of a delivery vehicle.
The business owner credited the loyal neighborhood customers whose refusal to remain passive ultimately led to the van being returned.

a1912fc071.h: Student thanks man who intervened during Huntingdon train attack
p: A student has expressed profound gratitude to the man she credits with saving her life last year.
Astrid stated that she owes her survival to Stephen Crean's actions when a violent incident occurred on a train in Huntingdon.

da20a14079.h: How Thalapathy Vijay's Rise May Reshape India's Electoral Map
p: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Vijay currently holds no seat in Parliament, yet his recent political triumph has generated a significant ripple effect. This development is poised to permanently transform the electoral landscape of the nation.
Looking ahead to the upcoming pivotal vote on delimitation, the political influence of the Tamil Nadu leader looms large despite his absence from the national legislature.

da84a0e418.h: تكنولوجيا روسية جديدة تتيح توجيه الحمام بأقطاب دماغية عن بُعد
p: بدأت مؤسسة تكنولوجية عصبية في روسيا تلقي طلبات تجارية لتوفير مهام التصوير الجوي بواسطة حمام مدمج بأقطاب كهربائية داخل الأنسجة الدماغية.
تمنح هذه التقنية البشر قدرة التحكم في مسار الطيور عن بعد، بما يمثل خطوة جديدة تنقل مفهوم الطائرات المسيرة نحو الكائنات الحية.

7b2b576f44.h: Coalition Neutralizes Houthi Drone Near Jeddah Islamic Port
p: Saudi Arabia's capital Riyadh witnessed an announcement from the Coalition to Restore Legitimacy in Yemen regarding an aerial attack near a major maritime facility. Maj. Gen. Turki Al-Maliki, who serves as the coalition spokesperson, stated that forces successfully intercepted and eliminated an explosive-laden unmanned aircraft sent by the Houthi militia.
The spokesperson confirmed that the operation concluded with no harm to local residents, despite the descent of wreckage resulting from the destruction of the aircraft close to Jeddah Islamic Port.

079bcba12f.h: Eagles Overcome 21-Point Deficit to Defeat Cowboys
p: Philadelphia mounted a dramatic comeback against Dallas after falling behind by 21 points early in the third quarter, when the score stood at 31-10.
Quarterback Joe Milton sparked the turnaround by connecting on a pair of long touchdown passes against his former club, helping his current team secure the surprising victory.

bed4c6c48e.h: NHS Leader Warns of Severe Influenza Surge and Rising Hospitalizations
p: A senior leader within the National Health Service has issued a warning regarding a severe surge in influenza cases, which is currently driving up hospital admissions.
In response to the growing crisis, health authorities are strongly advising vulnerable individuals to receive their flu vaccination without delay.

60556d2d08.h: Jaish operative plotting air base strike captured in Gujarat
p: Security forces in Gujarat have taken a Jaish-e-Mohammed operative into custody for plotting a strike against a military installation. The individual, identified as Mohammad Saharul Islam and originally from Assam, intended to target an air force facility located in Vadodara.
Authorities revealed that the suspect was preparing to carry out a solitary assault on the designated military base before being intercepted and arrested.

890c34bd33.h: تحرك حكومي صيني نادر يدفع الأسهم لأعلى مكاسب يومية منذ عامين
p: حققت الأسهم الصينية قفزة تاريخية هي الكبرى منذ أكثر من عامين، مدعومة بتدخل حكومي مباشر غير معمول به في أوقات التداول الاعتيادية.
وأصدرت الجهات الرسمية في الصين إعلاناً استثنائياً تضمن التزامات واضحة بتقديم مساندة قوية للأسواق المالية، مما انعكس بشكل مباشر على المؤشرات وسجل أدناً إيجابياً غير مسبوق خلال هذه الفترة.

03ab3f723b.h: وزيرة التضامن تتفاعل مع تساؤلات صلاح عبدالله بشأن تبرعات حادث الوراق
p: قامت وزيرة التضامن الاجتماعي الدكتورة مايا مرسي بالرد والتفاعل مع ما طرحه الفنان صلاح عبدالله في منشوره حول مصير التبرعات وطريقة توجيهها وصرفها.
جاء هذا التفاعل متزامناً مع نشر إنفوجراف يتناول تفاصيل الشفافية الكاملة وتوضيح سبل صرف كل جنيه تم تقديمه في حادث الوراق.

c06689e5f1.h: MoD Reaches Out to Former Service Members Regarding Potential Mobilisation
p: The Ministry of Defence has released public letters directed at nearly 100,000 former service personnel to inform them of their obligation to return to service during an emergency. However, the department struggled to locate direct contact information for roughly half of the intended recipients.

8097532bcc.h: New Zealand Launches Digital Portal for Graduate Work Visas
p: Immigration New Zealand has rolled out an updated digital platform specifically designed for graduate work visa submissions. This new online infrastructure aims to provide a smoother application journey for users.

Additionally, the portal includes features that allow candidates to easily monitor the status of their paperwork. The system has also been updated to incorporate the most recent visa policies and criteria.

a78feae8ad.h: Berlin woman goes on trial for alleged Russian espionage
p: A court case involving a Berlin resident charged with intelligence-gathering operations for Moscow has commenced following previous setbacks caused by medical concerns.
According to state attorneys, the accused leveraged her connections within the armed forces to supply details regarding German military capabilities and Ukraine.
